name: @funcd-dev/example-fn-to-fn
description: A two-function funcd example (ADR-0064): `front` calls `greeter` via context.invoke over a declared link. Authored in TypeScript against @funcd-dev/shim; vite build (@funcd-dev/vite-plugin) bundles BOTH src entry points to self-contained greeter.mjs + front.mjs in one build; each function's I/O contract lives in its <name>.funcdctl.yaml.
